_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER. Rough durations compiled from general industry knowledge, without a scheduler's input. Verify with a contractor before showing a schedule as more than a relative comparison.
_meta.basis: Weeks to top out = foundations + any wait for the structure beyond the foundation duration (procurement lead time) + floors x floor cycle. Durations at a 20,000 sf floor plate; foundations scale with sqrt(plate / reference), the floor cycle with (plate / reference) ^ cycle_scale_exponent.

foundations.note: Heavier buildings need bigger foundations: weeks = base + per_100_psf x seismic weight (psf) / 100, at the reference plate.

concrete.note: Cast in place, one floor at a time; little procurement lead.

steel.note: Mill order, shop drawings and fabrication before erection; deck and slab follow the frame.

mass_timber.note: Panels and glulam are prefabricated and go up quickly, but supplier lead times are long; the concrete core is assumed to keep pace.
